tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE PC Mikrotik CPU 24 Threads, 8GB ECC RAM DDR3, 4x 10G SFP+ Core Ethernet Router is a high-performance networking appliance engineered for ISPs, enterprise networks, data centers, and bandwidth-intensive environments. Powered by a robust 24-thread x86 processor and equipped with 8GB ECC DDR3 RAM, this router delivers exceptional routing efficiency, network security, and reliable performance for mission-critical applications.


Featuring 4× 10G SFP+ ports, the router provides ultra-fast fiber connectivity for core routing, network aggregation, backbone links, and server interconnection. The ECC memory architecture enhances system stability by reducing memory errors, ensuring uninterrupted operation in demanding networking environments.


Running MikroTik RouterOS, this enterprise-grade router supports advanced networking technologies including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VPN, VLAN, QoS, Load Balancing, and Firewall Management. Whether deployed as an ISP core router, enterprise gateway, or data center edge router, the D CORE Core Ethernet Router offers outstanding scalability, flexibility, and high-throughput performance.


Key Features


  • Processor (CPU): Intel Xeon E5-2678 V3, 2.40 GHz, Max Turbo 3.30 GHz, 35M Cache, Cores 12, Threads 24
  • MotherBoard: X99-XD4-V2.0 Server Motherboard
  • RAM: DDR3 1600BUS 8GB ECC Server RAM
  • License:  Mikrotik License with SSD
  • Port: 4 Port 10G SFP+
  • Power Supply: 550W
  • Mount: 4U Rack Mount Casing
